abstract: Best practices for hellajs-compiler, the JS-glue dual-target JSX engine: transform(code, options) option surface and call-time validation, target selection (dom imperative runtime for the client, ast HellaNode for the server), the pipeline contract (oxc TS strip that never typechecks, already-chained sourcemaps, non-byte-stable output), and when to consume the vite/rollup wrappers instead of calling the engine directly. Every rule is grounded in the plugin source and test suite.
